title: WPMS/1265/2011 of IRSHAD HUSSAIN Vs IIIRD ADDITIONAL DISTRICT JUDGE and OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND
AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 1265 of 2011 (M/S)
Irshad Hussain. Ö.Ö..Petitioner
Versus
3rd Addl. District Judge
Udham Singh Nagar and others ÖÖ.Ö..Respondents
With
Writ Petition No. 1239 of 2011 (M/S)
Pooran Chandra Tiwari. Ö..Petitioner
Versus
3rd Addl. District Judge
Udham Singh Nagar and others Ö..Respondents
Present:
Mr. R.S. Sammal, Advocate for the petitioners.
Mr. R.C. Arya, Standing Counsel for the State.
Mr. K.K. Sah, Advocate for the respondent Bank.
Honíble Alok Singh, J.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that he has
been instructed by the tenants to withdraw these petitions,
however, with the request to grant 18 months time to vacate the
building in question and hand over peaceful vacant possession
to the respondent/ landlord herein.
Learned counsel for the respondent landlord submits that
18 months time is on the higher side, therefore, one year time
may be granted to the petitioners to vacate and hand over
peaceful vacant possession to the landlord.
With the consent of learned counsel for the parties,
present petitions are disposed of with the following terms :-
1. Petitions are dismissed as withdrawn.
2. Petitioners shall hand over actual physical vacant
possession to the landlord on or before 30th April,
2015.

2
3. Petitioners shall pay entire arrears of rent till
28.11.2011 to the landlord or shall deposit with the
Prescribed Authority on or before 30th May, 2014,
after adjusting the amount already deposited /
paid.
4. Petitioners shall pay mesne profit at the agreed
monthly rent on or before 10th day of each and
every month from 29.11.2011 till physical actual
possession is handed over to the landlord.
5. Petitioners shall file undertaking to the above effect
with the Trial Court / Prescribed Authority on or
before 30th May, 2014 in the shape of their personal
affidavit.
6. If undertakings in the shape of affidavits are not
filed or any default is made in the payment of
arrears of rent or payment of monthly mesne profit,
landlord shall be entitled to evict the tenants
petitioners forthwith with the help of the Police.
All the pending applications stand disposed of.
 (Alok Singh, J.)
 30.04.2014
SKS
